title: Negotiation & Mediation — Consolidation
goal: Integrate subjunctive directives, formal purpose safeguards, reported bargaining shifts, counterfactual conditions and synthesis markers in C1 mediation discourse.

items: I can integrate subjunctive directives, formal purpose safeguards, reported bargaining shifts, counterfactual conditions and synthesis markers in C1 mediation discourse.
I can retrieve and apply all thirty-seven negotiation, de-escalation and arbitration terms across recognition, recall, context and production tasks.
